name: PitchControl
description: PitchControl is a free, open-source program that plays DMX
lights to the music: it listens to an audio input, fires the strobe on the
peaks and spreads colours and a moving mask across the fixtures of a rig.
It runs on macOS and Windows and sends DMX over USB and Art-Net.
This plugin writes one PitchControl fixture type file for each fixture,
with all of the fixture's DMX modes that PitchControl can use. The colour
channels become pixels, a strobe channel becomes PitchControl's shutter,
and every other channel is held at its default value. A mode with a
dimmer, amber or strobe per pixel, or with other layouts that PitchControl
can't repeat, is left out; a fixture without any usable mode can't be
exported. The file also keeps the fixture's original OFL data, so
PitchControl can show its links and the origin of the fixture.
The same conversion is built into PitchControl: File → Import Fixture →
Open Fixture Library makes the same type from an OFL fixture and shows
a report of what was taken and what was left out. As the fixtures are
written by volunteers, compare a type with the fixture's manual before
fixtureUsage: subdirectory of your PitchControl data folder, then restart PitchControl.
The types are listed on the Fixtures page, where a fixture type can
be edited and its modes are chosen for each fixture of a rig.
